Ah... so you made it. I wondered if you’d survive the darklings.
This isn’t just <slide a=.2>any fire.</slide>… what you’ve lit is one of the old hearts of the world.
You stand at the first <slide a=.2>Primordial Fire.</slide>, <wiggle a=.05 f=2>The Eternal Flame</wiggle>... it ties you, me, and all who will come.
Here, you can build, strengthen, shape... but it all comes at a cost. <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Gems</bounce>. Many gems.
I can help, of course. Gems can create structures, tools... even uncover secrets the shadows fear.
Purify them in the chest… <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Only then</bounce> will the Flame recognize them.
Ah, you’ve taken a spark from the flame. Good, It will guide you. If you <slide a=.2>let it.<slide a=.2>
The path to The Verdant Graveyard is open.
There, you’ll find the Armorer. He once kept the light alive for many, but those days are long gone
Go, and bring back what this place <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>needs</bounce> to grow.
Oh, and don't spend too long in there. There's much more to be done.
So, you brought back the Armorer. Good, I <slide a=.2>suppose </slide>... though I see you’re already <wiggle a=.05 f=2>throwing</wiggle> your gems at him.
One spark rekindled, and suddenly you think you're some kind of warden of the light?
There are <slide a=.2>others</slide> in The Verdant Graveyard who might actually be useful.
You’ll meet the Trainer, a <wave a=.2 f=1.5>fool</wave> who believes in strength through...<slide a=.2> odd</slide> means.
And the Tamer? He might turn that <wiggle a=.05 f=2>barking</wiggle> mutt of yours into <slide a=.2>something</slide> worth keeping around.
Let me guess - they’ll want <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>gems</bounce> too?
Just don’t forget what this is really about. That was only one flame. The world’s still <slide a=.2>drowning</slide> in shadow.
And I’m the one keeping this one alive. Bring back <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>enough</bounce> next time.
Ah, the flame grows brighter, and so does the crowd. Just don’t let them drain <dangle a=.2>too many</dangle> of my gems.
You’ve already rekindled the <wiggle a=.05 f=2>Eternal Flame</wiggle> here at the hub, one of the five <slide a=.2>Primordial Fires</slide>.
But don’t get comfortable. The true trial lies ahead.
The only path forward is deeper into <shake a=.4>The Lost Greens</shake>, where the Second <slide a=.2>Primordial Fire</slide> waits.
There, you’ll find <wave a=.2 f=1.5>The Watcher</wave>. She sees what others miss… and she’ll <wiggle a=.05 f=2>strengthen</wiggle> your emberlings.
entries.German: Dort wirst du <wave a=.2 f=1.5>Den Wächter</wave> finden. Sie sieht was andere übersehen… und sie wird deine Glutlinge <wiggle a=.05 f=2>verstärken</wiggle>.

entries.English: Light all four primordial flames, and a final path will open to the <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Fractured District</bounce>, a place long forgotten.
Go. And <slide a=.2>keep that fire of yours burning</slide>.
Heh. You’re tougher than you look... but you’re still blind to what really matters.
Two fires alive now. Two bonds reforged. The <slide a=.2>path</slide> widens, but the work only grows.
The <wiggle a=.05 f=2>Corrupted City</wiggle> waits. Once the heart of this place, now a <slide a=.2>shadow</slide> of itself, <shake a=.4>twisted</shake> and dangerous.
Lighting its flame won’t be easy. The darkness there is <dangle a=.2>thick</dangle>, and the work <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>heavy</bounce>.
You’ll need the <slide a=.2>Architect</slide>. A master of structures, someone who can turn ruins into refuge.
Bring him back here, to the Hub. Only then can you hope to <wiggle a=.05 f=2>kindle</wiggle> that fire.
Ah, the flames burn brighter with you around. <wiggle a=.05 f=2>Good, very good.</wiggle>
But the <slide a=.2>Corrupted City</slide>… it’s a beast not tamed yet.
Now, you face a choice: delve deeper into the Corrupted City to find an old relic, the Blueprint Altar...
or journey to the <slide a=.2>LumenHollow</slide>, a place heavy with orbs, ripe for the taking.
Survive that place, and maybe we can light a flame where none has burned in ages.
Hah… <bounce a=.2 f=1.1>The Blueprint Altar</bounce> has returned.
You’ve no idea what you've just set in motion, do you?
Time to lay down something that <slide a=.2>holds</slide> when the dark comes knocking.
Now let's get the second part of the plan in motion.
Scout the Hollow. If you can survive its bite, we’ll have a place to plant the flame.
That's all you need to know... <slide a=.2>for now.</slide>
You lived through the Hollow? <wiggle a=.05 f=1.5>Impressive.</wiggle>
We might just have a second site strong enough to house a flame.
But the ground still shifts there. We’ll need more than fire to hold it.
But first, head to the Corrupted City's and bring back the Blueprint Altar.
We'll need this powerful relic to restore the balance between light and dark.
Two footholds, one in ruin, one in rot. It’s a start.
Next step? Survive long enough to light one of them.
No more wandering blind. We set the first beacon. And the others will follow.
The Corrupted City fire... <slide a=.2>it lives again.</slide>
Even dimmed, its light bends the darkness around it.
You’ve done more than survive. You’ve started pushing back.
With it lit, we can open a path further out. Toward a place they call the Fractured District.
And when you’re ready... head back to the Hollow. We’ll need orbs. Lots of them.
Power for the next flame. Power to keep moving forward.
You reached the Fractured District? Bold.
That place is a scar that never closed. Feeding something deeper.
You’ve started gathering the fuel: <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>orbs</bounce>, pure and potent.
Every unit we store stabilizes the Hollow. Powers the structures. Keeps the flame breathing.
But it’s not just survival anymore. We’re preparing for something bigger.
Now <slide a=.2>brace yourself.</slide> The LumenHollow awaits, and it won’t give up its flame easily.
Start by collecting the orbs scattered through the Hollow. Each one of them will quiet the shadows… at least for a while.
The Throned Sentinel holds. The shadows retreat… temporarily.
However, the <slide a=.2>Fractured District</slide> still lingers in shadow, so let's move forward.
Fuel stacked. The <wiggle a=.05 f=1.5>LumenHollow</wiggle> is next. No more excuses.
Every orb you’ve collected will matter. <slide a=.2>Survive</slide>, and we can claim the next Primordial Fire
When it rises… the whole world will <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>tremble</bounce>.
The fourth Primordial Fire burns. <slide a=.2>Its light spreads</slide>, piercing the shadows that cling to the Hollow.
<wiggle a=.05 f=2>The Fractured District</wiggle> awaits. A city frozen in decay, where the old rulers still lurk.
Survive its twisted streets, uncover its secrets, and gather what you need to reach the <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>final flame</bounce>.
<slide a=.2>Step carefully.</slide> Shadows are patient, and the city <wiggle a=.05 f=2>hungry.</wiggle>
The 4 Primordial Fires still burn. You’ve held the line… but the final trial is near.
The Fractured District has tested you. Its streets whisper of the old rulers, their power twisted but not gone.
Gather your strength, ready your emberlings, and keep your dog close.
The heart of shadow awaits at <slide a=.2>Fractured City's peak</slide>.
All that stands between you and the end… is your courage, your fire, and your resolve.
You’ve done it. The shadow’s heart is no more. <bounce a=.3 f=1.6>The flames burn freely.</bounce>
Every ember, every spark… it all led to this. The world will <slide a=.2>remember</slide> the light you’ve restored.
Rest now, but not for long. The <wiggle a=.05 f=1.5>Primordial Fires</wiggle> are ancient. They may call again.
Tonight, though… you’ve given the world a chance to <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>breathe</bounce>, to see the light again.
The flame rests… but the world still hums. You’ll feel it, one day... the call to light it again.
<dangle a=.2>This</dangle> is what you’ve been fighting with? Looks like it was pulled from a junk pile.
Don’t worry, I’ll make sure you’ve got something that won’t embarrass us both.
I only take gems once they’re purified at the Flame. Don’t bring me raw junk.
<dangle a=.2>Well</dangle>, you took your time getting here. I’ve been stuck guarding this <shake a=.4>cursed</shake> nest, waiting for someone reckless enough to take it on
These Darklings won’t stop spreading unless you destroy it. I can’t leave while it’s still standing.
Clear it out, and I’ll join you at your hub. <dangle a=.2>Someone’s </dangle>got to make sure your weapons are worth a damn.
Not bad. Maybe you’re not as <dangle a=.2>useless</dangle> as you look. I’ll see you back at the flame.
You want to move <shake a=.4>faster</shake>, hit <shake a=.4>harder</shake>, or just carry <shake a=.4>more</shake> junk? I can make it happen... for a price.
These upgrades won’t make you<slide a=.2> invincible</slide>, but they’ll keep you alive a little longer.
Hmph. Another stray wandering into the ruins.
The Lost Greens had their own flame once. Bright. Defiant.
Now it’s just embers and rot. Maybe you'll change that.
I’ll see you at the flame... <slide a=.2>if you’re still standing.</slide>
That pup of yours has some fight in it, but it’s <wiggle a=.05 f=2>wasted</wiggle> without proper training.
With the right skills, that dog won’t just <wiggle a=.05 f=2>follow</wiggle> you. It’ll <slide a=.2>save your life</slide>.
<slide a=.2>Easy now…</slide> not every shadow out here wants you dead. Not yet.
When the flame lit up again... he felt it, didn’t he?
Tail low, ears up: like something ancient just <wiggle a=.05 f=2>called</wiggle> to him.
I’ll head to your hub... <slide a=.2>if my lungs don’t give out first.</slide>
Well, <slide a=.2>look what we got here...</slide>
This fluffball’s more than just a cute face, he’s got a knack for boosting the little emberlings.
<slide a=.15>And don’t let his wagging tail fool ya</slide>: he’ll fetch your gear quicker than you can light a smoke
Now <bounce a=.3 f=1.3>this one’s</bounce> no ordinary mutt.
<shake a=.4>Dark energy</shake> cracklin’ beneath that fur: he’ll blast through enemies like they’re nothin’ but ash”
<shake a=.4>Be warned, he knows neither mercy nor rest.</shake>
The emberlings follow instinct, but with the right guidance… <slide a=.2>they could do more</slide>.
entries.German: Glutlinge folgen ihren Instinkten, aber mit der richtigen Führung… <slide a=.2>können sie so viel mehr sein</slide>.

entries.English: I can teach them<bounce a=.2 f=1.2> new roles</bounce>, <shake a=.4>sharpen</shake> their senses, make them <wiggle a=.05 f=2>follow your lead</wiggle>.
With time, they’ll be more than just <dangle a=.2>flickering sparks</dangle>.
<wiggle a=.05 f=2>The Lost Greens</wiggle>... a seed of flame lies buried here, waiting to be rekindled.
Without that fire, the dark will choke these lands, and nothing will stand.
Survive the nights, push them back. Show this land the fire <shake a=.4>still burns</shake>.
Prey is plentiful, though the easiest hunts won’t sustain you forever.
Sooner or later, you’ll need to venture<slide a=.2> further</slide>, into<wiggle a=.05 f=2> wilder</wiggle> grounds.
Hah… You held your ground. The dark <wave a=.2 f=1.5>hates</wave> persistence.
You’ve earned your place here. <wiggle a=.05 f=2>The Lost Greens</wiggle> will remember you.
The emberlings are yours to shape. <slide a=.2>Bring them to me</slide>, and I’ll make them last.
entries.German: Die Glutlinge sind für dich sie zu formen. <slide a=.2>Bring sie zu mir</slide>, und ich werde sie legendär machen.

entries.English: These small wanderers were <wiggle a=.05 f=2>drained</wiggle> by shadow’s touch.
Some say they were once human. Others whisper they were born from the <slide a=.2>Flame itself</slide>.
They speak little... but they listen.
Those <wiggle a=.05 f=2>Scavengers</wiggle> you found: they’re more than wanderers now.
<slide a=.2>Train them well</slide>, and they’ll bring you treasures from the shadows.
<bounce a=.3 f=1.5>Engineers,</bounce> the hands that build hope from ashes.
Masters of structure and trap alike.
Give them the tools, <wiggle a=.05 f=2>and watch your defenses bloom.</wiggle>
<dangle a=.2>Guards</dangle>, the shield against the dark.
They hold the line so you don’t have to.
Strengthen their resolve, <slide a=.2>and the shadows will falter.</slide>
LumenHollow… <shake a=.4>grows wilder by the hour.</shake>
But it grows fast. Too fast. <shake a=.4>This place doesn’t play fair.</shake>
I found something old, <shake a=.4>pulsing</shake> with intent.
An <slide a=.2>artifact</slide> of balance. Of control.
Feed it orbs, and it will hold the night back… For a while.
And every orb sent into it travels home, Straight to the hub, <wiggle a=.05 f=2>toward the convoy effort.</wiggle>
Ah, you’re here at last. I’ve hauled this old pack all the way here.
That darkling nest… if it still <wiggle a=.05 f=2>lurks</wiggle>, it’s blocking your path back. You’ll need to clear it first.
No shortcuts through <slide a=.2>shadows</slide>, young one.
If you manage that, I’ll try to make it back to the Hub. Though at my age, <wiggle a=.05 f=2>the road grows heavy</wiggle>.
We’ll see if these old bones hold. See you at the flame.
I’m here to <slide a=.2>help you build</slide> stronger, smarter. Structures that last longer, protect better.
There’s an old relic, forgotten by most. My architect’s table.
It lets you <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>reshape your camp</bounce>, move structures where you need them.
But its secrets are buried deep, in the heart of the <slide a=.2>Corrupted City.</slide>
For now, let’s make what you have <slide a=.2>better than before.</slide>
This relic holds the power to reshape your base.
Move, improve, build anew. Use it wisely, for the fire depends on it.
Rubble like this? <shake a=.3>Let your miners do the lifting.</shake>
Just... be ready. <wave a=.15>Every stone moved</wave> might wake what’s hiding beneath.
They clear the mess. You hold the line.
<bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Engineers</bounce>, hm? Smart hands, steady minds. Just what this place needs.
<slide a=.2>LumenHollow</slide> doesn’t give second chances. I’ve outfitted the camp with a few Sniper Towers.
Let your engineers man them. They see farther, shoot sharper.
Ah, a fresh face! <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Welcome, welcome!</bounce>
Call me whatever you like, most just say "The SporeMonger"
I trade oddities. <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Spores, scraps</bounce>, things that don’t belong yet still survive.
Stick close to the fire, friend. Out here, <slide a=.2>the dark is always hungry.</slide>
This place? <slide a=.2>Tick, tick, tick…</slide> Danger grows fast, friend.
You linger too long, and the nights will <wiggle a=.05 f=3>swallow you whole.</wiggle>
I found something old, <shake a=.4>pulsing</shake> with intent.
Feed it orbs, and it will hold the night back… For a while.
Best thing? Those orbs don’t vanish. I’ve seen the trails… They’re going somewhere.
Toward a plan, maybe? A convoy? Hah… just guessing.
Ah, back so soon! <bounce a=.2 f=1.2>Good.</bounce>
I’m the mushroom in your merchants’ stew, adding <slide a=.2>spices</slide>, new tricks, and traps
